Section header style

Source: R/headers.R
section_header_style.Rd

Section header style

Usage

section_header_style(
  title_style = NULL,
  refs_style = NULL,
  marker_color = "accent",
  marker_width = 4/96,
  marker_height = 16/96,
  marker_gap = 10/96,
  refs_gap = 8/96,
  rule = line_style("primary", 0.75),
  space_above = 0.065,
  rule_gap = 0.0875,
  space_below = 0.08
)

Arguments

title_style, refs_style

Text styles (or role names) for the title and references. Default roles `section` and `refs`.

marker_color

Colour of the marker before the title (theme names allowed); `NA` for none.

marker_width, marker_height

Marker size.

marker_gap

Space between marker and title.

refs_gap

Space between title and references.

rule

A [line_style()] for the rule under the title, or `NULL`.

space_above

Space above the title line.

rule_gap

Space between the title line and the rule.

space_below

Space below the rule.

Value

A `bb_section_header_style` object.

Examples

section_header_style(marker_color = NA, rule = line_style("primary", 1))
#> $title_style
#> NULL
#> 
#> $refs_style
#> NULL
#> 
#> $marker_color
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $marker_width
#> [1] 0.04166667
#> 
#> $marker_height
#> [1] 0.1666667
#> 
#> $marker_gap
#> [1] 0.1041667
#> 
#> $refs_gap
#> [1] 0.08333333
#> 
#> $rule
#> $color
#> [1] "primary"
#> 
#> $lwd
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $lty
#> [1] "solid"
#> 
#> $alpha
#> NULL

#>
